name: order-digest-deployed-exchange
description: EIP-712 digest of one CTFExchange Order under the XO Market CLOB domain, exactly as the deployed exchange's hashOrder returns it. Encoding: salt, tokenId, makerAmount, takerAmount, expiration and nonce are base-10 decimal strings (they are uint256/uint128); chainId is a JSON integer; maker, signer, beneficiary and exchange are 0x-hex addresses (any case); identifier is 0x-hex bytes16; metadata is 0x-hex bytes32; side is 0 (BUY) or 1 (SELL); signatureType is 0 (EOA) or 3 (Kernel smart account). expectedDigest is the full EIP-712 digest (0x1901 || domainSeparator || structHash). domain is the full EIP-712 domain the digest is computed under: it equals name "XO Market CLOB", version "1", inputs.chainId and the checksummed inputs.exchange, and no other domain field (no salt).
source: Read from the mainnet CTFExchange's hashOrder with a read-only call (cast call on chain 3223, the order passed with an empty signature) on 2026-10-30. The SDK's hashOrder gives the same digest, and the exchange's eip712Domain() returns exactly domain.
typeString: Order(uint256 salt,address maker,address signer,address beneficiary,uint256 tokenId,uint256 makerAmount,uint256 takerAmount,uint256 expiration,uint128 nonce,bytes16 identifier,bytes32 metadata,uint8 side,uint8 signatureType)
